It is a strict output-identity guard, and docs/32 already establishes that the overlay is not numerically identical (+0.000065 mean KLD on the context recipe), so a failure here is a measurement of where the arithmetic difference becomes visible in greedy decoding, not a defect

verdict.decision_rule: recommend as a default only if the overlay is output-identical AND buys KV the profile needs; recommend as an opt-in if the frozen schedule does not regress and there is real KV headroom to gain; otherwise do not mention it on these cards
verdict.statement: At the published 8,192-token profiles, VLLM_EXL3_EMBED_BITS=8 measured: hyd: weights 20.31 -> 19.14 GiB (-1.17), available KV 66.45 -> 67.62 GiB = 668852 -> 680899 tokens (+12047, +1.80 %), concurrency at 8,192 81.65x -> 83.12x, probe 22/22 correct on both arms, 9/22 continuations token-identical (first divergence between tokens 32 and 137, max chosen-logprob delta 1.714226); k5k6: weights 20.56 -> 19.38 GiB (-1.18), available KV 56.87 -> 58.06 GiB = 345324 -> 352571 tokens (+7247, +2.10 %), concurrency at 8,192 42.15x -> 43.04x, probe 22/22 correct on both arms, 12/22 continuations token-identical (first divergence between tokens 49 and 116, max chosen-logprob delta 1.617807). Verdict: mention it on the hydrated and online K5-K6 cards as an OPT-IN memory lever, not as a default. It does what docs/32 says - about 1.2 GiB of weights become KV, which at 8,192 tokens is +1.8 % (hydrated) and +2.1 % (online K5-K6) of KV tokens and about one point of concurrency - and it costs no correctness on the frozen schedule (22/22 planted answers, zero corruption detectors, on all four arms). But it is NOT output-identical: with greedy decoding the continuations diverge from the BF16-table arm on 13 of 22 (hydrated) and 10 of 22 (online K5-K6) requests, tens of tokens in, with chosen-token logprob deltas up to 1.71. That is the expected consequence of the +0.000065 mean KLD docs/32 already published, not a new defect, but it means the overlay must not be presented as a free switch on a recipe whose KV is already 42x-82x the window: a reader who flips it gets different text for the same prompt. Recommend it where KV is the binding constraint - long windows, smaller cards, the context edition it was built for - and say plainly that output changes.
verdict.scope: 22 frozen probe requests of 1,024-6,144 prompt tokens inside an 8,192 window, greedy, concurrency 1. This is a served-output guard, not a KLD measurement: the overlay's fidelity cost is the +0.000065 mean KLD already published in docs/32 / receipts/paired-ctx-embed8.json.
